$comment: The explicit allowlist. A pair in contrast-pairs.json that falls below its minimum and is NOT listed here fails the gate; a pair listed here that starts passing ALSO fails the gate, so an entry cannot outlive the problem it describes. `reason` is mandatory and is what a reviewer reads; `decision` names what would let the entry be deleted. Adding an entry is a design decision, not a build fix — see AGENTS.md.

failures.reason: reported in the intake; awaiting the design decision
failures.decision: tokens.json already annotates text.placeholder as never-real-text. The row stays exempt only while every field carries a visible label above it (COMPONENTS.md, Text field); if a field ever ships placeholder-as-label, this becomes a hard failure

failures.reason: reported in the intake; awaiting the design decision
failures.decision: same as text.placeholder/surface.default, on the muted field variant

failures.reason: reported in the intake; awaiting the design decision
failures.decision: the disabled primary button is white on slate.300. WCAG 1.4.3 exempts disabled controls, but 1.52:1 is unreadable rather than merely dimmed. Either darken the disabled fill or switch the disabled label to text.tertiary

failures.reason: reported in the intake; awaiting the design decision
failures.decision: the card edge is decorative — the card is also carried by shadow.card — so this row may end up annotated decorative-only rather than darkened. It is listed rather than deleted so the decision is recorded

failures.reason: reported in the intake; awaiting the design decision
failures.decision: the ring is cobalt.500 at 35 % alpha, which composites to #B5C0F2 on white. The focus indicator is the one thing a keyboard user has; 1.78:1 does not satisfy 1.4.11. Raise the alpha to opaque cobalt, or ship a two-tone ring with an opaque inner edge

failures.reason: reported in the intake; awaiting the design decision
failures.decision: same ring, measured on the page rather than on a card. Whatever fixes focus-ring/surface.default fixes this; both rows stay so neither surface is forgotten
